description: #531 parity: 1D advection with WENO5 grad rule on periodic domain. MOL #531 rules_weno.jl _weno_template fires on Dx(u) (= grad in ESS), not on div(U·q); this fixture covers the interior WENO5 1st-derivative case at the pinned SHA. Finding: weno5_advection.json applies_to is div(U*q,x) and does NOT match the grad(u,x) pattern from #531 WENO — weno5_grad.json was added as the thin alias (esd-ubz).

tolerance.notes: WENO5 weights involve (ε+β_k)^2 with ε=1e-6; for smooth Gaussian IC the nonlinear weights are well-separated and the result is reproducible to ~1e-13 across bindings. The Julia evaluator is the reference.

fixtures.name: advection_periodic
fixtures.notes: 80-cell uniform grid on [0,2] with periodic BCs. Gaussian IC from MOL #531 Test 00: u(x)=(0.5/(0.2*sqrt(2*pi)))*exp(-(x-1)^2/(2*0.04)). du/dx approximated by weno5_grad (= MOL _weno_template output at all cells with periodic wrapping).
